skill_atlas.help.browse.1: Left-click a skill to view details, Shift + left-click or Ctrl + left-click to learn or upgrade it directly.
skill_atlas.help.browse.2: Drag the canvas to pan, scroll to zoom around the cursor; Home fits the view, Space centers it, 0 resets zoom to 100%.
skill_atlas.help.browse.3: Switch categories on the left, or with Tab / Shift + Tab and number keys 1 - 9; Ctrl + F searches names, pinyin, aliases and descriptions.
skill_atlas.help.browse.4: Hidden skills stay invisible until their prerequisites are met.
skill_atlas.help.edit.1: With permission, click the edit button in the toolbar to enter edit mode.
skill_atlas.help.edit.2: Right-click empty space and choose "New skill", or double-click empty space to create one.
skill_atlas.help.edit.3: Double-click a skill or press Enter / F2 to open the editor.
skill_atlas.help.edit.4: Drag skills to move them (hold Alt to disable grid snapping); arrow keys move by one grid cell, Shift + arrow keys move finely.
skill_atlas.help.edit.5: Drag on empty space to box-select, Ctrl + click toggles selection, Ctrl + A selects all, Ctrl + D clears the selection; select several skills to batch edit them.
skill_atlas.help.edit.6: Hold Shift and drag from one skill to another to add a prerequisite; right-click a line to hide it or remove the prerequisite.
skill_atlas.help.edit.7: Ctrl + C / X / V to copy, cut and paste, Delete to remove, Ctrl + Z to undo; copied skills are also written to the system clipboard.
skill_atlas.help.edit.8: In the editor, click "Level N" to open a separate window for that level's cost, rewards and required items.
skill_atlas.help.keys.1: Enter / F2: edit the selected skill, or batch edit several
skill_atlas.help.keys.2: Double-click a skill: open the editor; double-click empty space: create a skill there
skill_atlas.help.keys.3: Delete / Backspace: delete the selected skills (asks first); Shift + Delete: delete without asking
skill_atlas.help.keys.4: Ctrl + C / Ctrl + X / Ctrl + V: copy, cut, paste (pastes at the mouse); Ctrl + Shift + V: paste without prerequisites pointing to other skills
skill_atlas.help.keys.5: Ctrl + A: select all skills in this category; Ctrl + D: clear the selection
skill_atlas.help.keys.6: Ctrl + click: toggle one skill; Shift or Ctrl + drag on empty space: add to the selection
skill_atlas.help.keys.7: Arrow keys: move the selection by one grid step; Shift + arrows: move by 1 pixel
skill_atlas.help.keys.8: Hold Alt while dragging a skill: don't snap to the grid
skill_atlas.help.keys.9: Shift + drag from one skill to another: add a prerequisite
skill_atlas.help.keys.10: Right-click a skill, a line or empty space: open the edit menu
skill_atlas.help.keys.11: Home: fit view; Space: center view; 0: reset zoom to 100%; + / -: zoom; Ctrl + F: search
skill_atlas.help.keys.14: Tab / Shift + Tab: next / previous category; 1 - 9: jump to the Nth category
skill_atlas.help.keys.15: Ctrl + Z: undo your last edit (up to 50 steps)
skill_atlas.help.keys.16: Hold F1 while hovering a skill: show its ID and position
skill_atlas.help.keys.17: With skills selected, right-click another skill: add or remove prerequisites in bulk; right-click a skill to copy its ID
skill_atlas.help.nodes.1: A skill can have several levels, each with its own cost and rewards; only the rewards of the current level apply.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.2: Attribute rewards support add, multiply base and multiply total operations.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.3: Periodic effects keep granting a status effect at an interval; effect immunity removes and blocks an effect.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.4: Command rewards run once as the player when that level is reached.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.5: Each prerequisite can show or hide its line; hidden skills stay invisible until their prerequisites are met.
skill_atlas.help.nodes.6: Each level can spend raw experience or skill points and require items from the inventory and offhand. Deleting or resetting a skill refunds recorded payments, but not items.
skill_atlas.help.points.1: Skill point costs use the category's selected pool. Each pool has an earning method, max progress and progress description. Categories can have no pool, and each level can independently spend raw experience instead.
skill_atlas.help.points.2: Earning methods: killing, mining, harvesting mature crops, crafting, smelting, fishing, movement distance, advancements and play time; kills can be limited to hostile mobs.
skill_atlas.help.points.3: Recorded skill point or experience payments are refunded when a skill is deleted or reset.
